note: 12 claims: 9 confirmed, 2 corrected, 1 unverified; most round 1 errors are fixed, but the new guide omits the 2-minute authorization code lifetime and leaves the production host unverified although the docs give account.docusign.com/oauth/auth.

rows.composio: Admin > Integrations > Apps and Keys > Add App and Integration Key.
rows.ours: Free developer account, then Developer Console > Apps and Keys: create an app, note the integration key, add a secret.
rows.provider: Apps and Keys still works; the Developer Console (open beta) is now 'the single location where you can manage (IKs) across both the demo and production environments.'

rows.composio: Add URI under Additional Settings; must match character-for-character.
rows.ours: At least one redirect URI required; changes take up to 5 minutes to propagate; not copied to production at Go-Live.
rows.provider: Re-read (page data): 'You must define at least one redirect URI... You may set more than one redirect URI per app'; changes to redirect URIs 'can take up to five minutes to fully propagate'; redirect URIs cannot contain fragments. Exact-match wording not found. The guide is right; it omits only the multiple-URI and no-fragment details.

rows.composio: Optional 'Require PKCE' setting on a confidential app; can be left off.
rows.ours: Public clients use PKCE with code_challenge S256 and no secret; confidential clients use a secret.
rows.provider: Public ACG 'uses Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) to authenticate securely without requiring a client secret'; confidential ACG may add PKCE; method s256.

rows.claim: Refresh tokens and the extended scope
rows.ours: Request signature plus extended; extended enables near-indefinite refresh; refresh tokens last about 30 days.
rows.provider: Refresh tokens last 'typically around 30 days'; with extended each refresh issues a full-lifetime token, without it the original expiry stays.

rows.ours: Access tokens last 8 hours by default.
rows.provider: Token responses show expires_in 28800 (8 hours); Docusign recommends refreshing when close to expiry, e.g. within 30 minutes.
Re-read: 'The authorization code is only viable for two minutes. If more than two minutes pass... the operation will fail.'

rows.composio: Developer uses account-d.docusign.com; production uses account.docusign.com.
rows.ours: Demo hosts account-d.docusign.com/oauth/auth and /oauth/token given; production host left unverified ('likely account.docusign.com').
rows.provider: Re-read: developer base URI https://account-d.docusign.com/oauth/auth; 'For the production environment, the base URI is https://account.docusign.com/oauth/auth'; token at /oauth/token on each host.

rows.ours: Paid production account with admin access and access to each API; ISV partners may get a free management account.
rows.provider: 'You have a paid production account to manage the integration in production'; ISV partners may qualify for a free management account; admin access required.

rows.ours: Manual reviews typically take 24-48 hours (wait 1-2 days); identity verification may allow promotion.
rows.provider: 'Manual reviews are typically completed within 24–48 hours'; some apps get automatic promotion after one-time identity verification.

rows.ours: Not covered; Go-Live step only asks to confirm API limits and OAuth 2.0 use, no call count.
rows.provider: Re-read: current Go-Live requirements list a paid production account, admin access, API access, API limits/OAuth 2.0 and classification; no API-call count appears, but the page never says one was removed. The guide matches the current list.

rows.claim: What carries over to production after Go-Live
rows.composio: Create a separate config pointing to account.docusign.com with the production key.
rows.ours: After promotion, set the secret and redirect URIs again in production since they are not copied.
rows.provider: Re-read: key is 'copied to the production environment, rather than moved' (same key in demo and production); 'secrets and redirect URIs are not copied automatically'.

rows.claim: Userinfo call returns the base URI
rows.ours: GET account-d.docusign.com/oauth/userinfo with Bearer token returns name, email and accounts with base_uri (marked inferred).
rows.provider: GET https://account-d.docusign.com/oauth/userinfo (account.docusign.com in production) returns account_id and base_uri; hourly rate limits apply.
